root_scope: Read full note and index. Independently opened pinned CPython3.12.11 posixmodule.c and Apple kqueue manual; confirmed Apple exclusion of Python waitid and distinct NOTE_EXIT/NOTE_REAP semantics. This supports a source-design route, not installed runtime/API/ABI evidence.
source_requirements: Two distinct finite operations and future admissions, preserving the existing reviewed helpers and native actual.
Same-PID new-session wrapper stops before exact helper exec. Bounded exact-child WUNTRACED handshake, SID/PGID certificate and kqueue NOTE_EXIT registration precede raw SIGCONT.

Keep the Popen child strongly referenced and unreaped while group signals may be needed. No implicit poll/wait/context/destructor/Popen signal-method reap, competing waiter or SIGCHLD reaper. Set documented SIGCHLD default before launch.
Use only supported named API constants; no waitid, invented EV_RECEIPT/NOTE_TRACK, ctypes, raw syscall, process/provider discovery or extra probe.
Handle pre-certificate setup failures using only the fresh direct-child ownership that is actually known; never guess a process group. Unknown cleanup remains incomplete.

Abnormal group cleanup uses raw signals while the ownership anchor is retained, then deliberate wait/reap and independent ESRCH. Normal completion requires full positive receipt, raw child0, deliberate reap, group absence and raw outer0.
All startup, handshake, helper, query, cleanup and complete serialization stay inside whole60s/query5s/TERM8s/inclusive32MiB/thread1/no-retry limits. No invented sampled RSS pass or hardquota.
Declare any new select/stdlib imports and unobserved installed API/origin assumptions explicitly. Existing native runtime maps are unchanged and do not establish complete closure for this new owner.
